notes_for_editor: Thin record. One online list (tnlandforms.us, tags BLL-65230 and gfc-844 as printed) is the only source found that names a tower at Colesburg. The NHLR Georgia list and the eastern lookouts Georgia page show no Colesburg entry. The eastern page does list a Camden County Georgia Forestry Commission tower at Hazzards Neck; this record is not linked to it. The list's point is about 139 m from the marker list's corner coordinates, a distance calculated from the two coordinate pairs. The list's 'usgs' and 'BLL' tags are not explained on the page.
